items.headline: Nvidia fell about 14% on Friday and roughly 23% on the week after record earnings, its seventh straight weekly loss
items.why: The market's bellwether for AI spending sold off even on a beat-and-raise quarter, so the AI trade is now being repriced on accounting and sustainability worries rather than on results.

sources.title: U.S. Stock Market Weekly Update Ending Nov. 20, 2026

items.headline: Anthropic's Nasdaq IPO priced at $83, above its $70-78 range, and rose about 17% on its first day before giving back part of it Friday
items.why: A roughly $1.5 trillion debut shows capital is still willing to pay up for frontier AI developers even while chip stocks are being sold, and Friday's pullback shows how fragile that appetite is.

items.headline: Bitcoin closed the week near $58,800, down about 14%, after breaking below $60,000 and hitting its lowest level since July
items.why: Crypto is trading as a high-beta risk asset alongside the equity selloff, and losing $60,000 removes a level many traders were using as the floor.

items.headline: Ether fell about 16% on the week to roughly $1,620 as total crypto market cap slipped toward $2.1 trillion
items.why: Ether is falling faster than Bitcoin, which is the usual sign of risk reduction rather than rotation inside crypto.

items.headline: Futures priced about a 96% chance of a Federal Reserve rate hike in December
items.why: Markets are pricing tightening rather than cuts, which is the main reason equities, gold and crypto are all being sold at the same time.

items.headline: The 10-year Treasury yield ended the week near 4.9% after falling about 20 basis points
items.why: Yields fell during a risk-off week, so bonds are being bid as a haven even though rate-hike expectations remain high.

items.headline: Asian equities sold off hard on Friday, with the Nikkei down about 5% and Kospi down about 5% in live trading
items.why: The selloff is global rather than a US-only move, so there is no regional safe harbour for equity risk.

items.headline: Gold fell to around $3,520-3,540 on Friday, a 14-month low, with December futures down more than 4% on the day
items.why: Gold is not acting as a haven in this selloff: rate-hike pricing and forced liquidation are outweighing safe-haven demand.

sources.title: Stocks Slide Again, Bitcoin Nears $62K and Gold Hits a 14-Month Low

items.headline: WTI crude held near $83-84 a barrel and Brent near $90 despite the equity rout
items.why: Oil is holding up while other assets fall, which keeps an energy-driven inflation risk alive and supports the case for a hike.

items.headline: The S&P 500 closed at 6,910, down 8.6% on the week, after seven straight down sessions and a break below 7,000
items.why: It is the worst weekly decline since April 2025 and the index is now in correction territory, so prior support near 7,000 has become resistance.

sources.title: U.S. Stock Market Weekly Update Ending Nov. 20, 2026

items.headline: The Dow closed below 50,000 for the first time since June, and the Nasdaq Composite fell to about 22,600, down 10% on the week
items.why: Both indexes lost a major round-number level, and a 10% weekly drop in the Nasdaq marks a structure break rather than a routine pullback.

sources.title: U.S. Stock Market Weekly Update Ending Nov. 20, 2026

items.headline: The VIX volatility index jumped about a third to the mid-to-high 30s
items.why: A VIX in the high 30s signals stress and forced de-risking, a regime where moves of 2-3% a day are normal and levels are less reliable.
